faqs.question: Propose day kab hai 2026 mein tha, aur 2027 mein kab hai?
faqs.answer: In 2026 Propose Day fell on Sunday 8 February. In 2027 it is Monday 8 February — सोमवार, 8 फ़रवरी 2027. The date is the same both years; only the weekday moved, from an open Sunday to a working Monday.

faqs.question: Propose day kab aata hai — kya date har saal badalti hai?
faqs.answer: यह तारीख़ हर साल नहीं बदलती: it is 8 February every year. Propose Day is fixed to the Gregorian calendar, unlike Holi or Diwali, which are set by the Hindu lunisolar calendar and land on different dates each year.

faqs.question: Propose day kitne tarikh ko hai?
faqs.answer: The eighth — 8 फ़रवरी. Rose Day is on the seventh and Valentine's Day on the fourteenth, so Propose Day is day two of the eight dated days between 7 and 14 February.

faqs.question: Propose de kab hai? (spelt without the second 'y')
faqs.answer: Same day: Monday 8 February 2027. 'Propose de' is a common typed variant of 'propose day' and returns the same occasion — the second day of Valentine week.

faqs.question: Kya 8 February 2027 ko chhutti hai?
faqs.answer: नहीं — 8 फ़रवरी 2027 को काम का दिन है. Propose Day is not a gazetted holiday in any year, and in 2027 it lands on a Monday, so assume a normal working day rather than the open Sunday of 2026.

faqs.question: Rose Day aur Valentine's Day 2027 mein kab hain?
faqs.answer: Rose Day is Sunday 7 February 2027 and Valentine's Day is Sunday 14 February 2027. Both anchors of the week fall on Sundays in 2027, which leaves Propose Day as the workday sitting between them.

faqs.question: Propose Day Valentine week ka kaun sa din hai?
faqs.answer: The second. Valentine week runs 7 to 14 February inclusive, which is eight dated days rather than seven, and Propose Day is the day after Rose Day.

faqs.question: Why does the same date land on a different weekday each year?
faqs.answer: Because 365 is not divisible by 7, a fixed date shifts forward one weekday most years and two after a leap year. That is why 8 February was a Sunday in 2026 and is a Monday in 2027 while the date itself never changed.

faqs.question: Is there a Hindi word for Propose Day?
faqs.answer: Not a native one. It is written as a transliteration — प्रपोज़ डे — and neither McGregor's Oxford Hindi-English Dictionary nor Platts records it as a Hindi headword, which is why this page labels it a transliteration rather than vocabulary.

faqs.question: Should the message itself be in Hindi or in English?
faqs.answer: Use whichever language you two actually speak to each other in. Worth knowing before you choose: every SubhSandesh template named on this page is English-language, so the buttons and labels stay English even when your own words are Hindi.

faqs.question: How long before the day do people usually start building something?
faqs.answer: There is no proposal-specific figure — that read is refused by this machine's production-read policy. What is measurable platform-wide is the median gap between a page's first save and its last edit: 2.2 hours, sampled on the apology dashboard, n=1,375.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Propose Day Kab Hai: सोमवार, 8 फ़रवरी 2027 (Monday)

**प्रपोज़ डे सोमवार, 8 फ़रवरी 2027 को है** — *propose ḍe somvār, 8 farvarī 2027 ko hai* — "Propose Day is on Monday, 8 February 2027."

It is the second of Valentine week's eight dated days, not the first: Rose Day opens the week on Sunday 7 February 2027, and Valentine's Day closes it on Sunday 14 February 2027.

The weekday is the part worth knowing. Propose Day 2026 fell on a Sunday; 2027 lands on a working Monday, and two numbers from SubhSandesh's own database say what that changes. Across the 5,148 personalised pages created since 12 March 2026 — platform-wide, across all 21 page types — 48.3% of views arrive on a phone, 27,499 of 56,886.

Below: the date in both scripts, the whole week with its Hindi weekday names, whether the date can move, and why this question gets asked in Hindi at all.

## What Propose Day is, and what it is not

Propose Day is the second day of Valentine week, the 7–14 February sequence in which each date carries a name. It is a dated convention — not a religious observance, not a gazetted holiday, and not fixed by any lunar reckoning.

Two things it is not. In ordinary Indian usage *propose karna* means asking someone to be your girlfriend or boyfriend, not asking them to marry you — the sibling page on [what "propose karna" means in Hindi](/blog/propose-day-meaning-in-hindi) covers that. And it is not the opening day; Rose Day is.

I could not establish when or where the day-by-day naming of Valentine week began. Two searches across Crossref and Europe PMC — "Valentine week invented tradition South Asia day by day structure" and "Rose Day Propose Day Valentine week India origin study" — returned nothing about the practice, and two earlier batches in this cluster reported the same absence. Treat any page that states an origin confidently as unsourced.

## प्रपोज़ डे कब है — five questions inside one query

People type *propose day kab hai* and four close variants, and they are not the same question. Each entry gives the Hindi form, the answer, what sits behind it, and what it changes.

### 1. प्रपोज़ डे कब है? — "When is Propose Day?"

**Asked as:** प्रपोज़ डे कब है? (*propose ḍe kab hai?*)
**Answer:** प्रपोज़ डे सोमवार, 8 फ़रवरी 2027 को है — Monday, 8 February 2027.
**Behind it:** the bare date, wanted in the first line.
**What it changes:** nothing yet. This is the lookup; every other question starts once it is answered.

### 2. प्रपोज़ डे कब आता है? — "When does Propose Day come round?"

**Asked as:** प्रपोज़ डे कब आता है? (*propose ḍe kab ātā hai?*)
**Answer:** यह तारीख़ हर साल नहीं बदलती — *yah tārīḵẖ har sāl nahīṁ badaltī*, "this date does not change from year to year." It is always 8 February.
**Behind it:** a reasonable Indian assumption. Holi, Diwali and Raksha Bandhan all move, being set by the [Hindu lunisolar calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindu_calendar), not a Gregorian date.
**What it changes:** you can plan 2028 today. Only the weekday moves.

### 3. प्रपोज़ डे किस तारीख़ को है? — "On what date is it?"

**Asked as:** प्रपोज़ डे किस तारीख़ को है? (*propose ḍe kis tārīḵẖ ko hai?*), and colloquially *kitne tarikh ko*.
**Answer:** 8 फ़रवरी — the eighth. Rose Day is 7 फ़रवरी, Valentine's Day 14 फ़रवरी.
**Behind it:** a check against something half-remembered from last February.
**What it changes:** it settles the ordering. Propose Day is day two of eight, and Rose Day has already gone.

### 4. क्या उस दिन छुट्टी है? — "Is it a holiday that day?"

**Asked as:** क्या उस दिन छुट्टी है? (*kyā us din chuṭṭī hai?*)
**Answer:** नहीं. 8 फ़रवरी 2027 को काम का दिन है — *8 farvarī 2027 ko kām kā din hai*, "8 February 2027 is a working day." It is not a gazetted holiday in any year.
**Behind it:** 2026 में प्रपोज़ डे रविवार को था — in 2026 it fell on a Sunday, so last year's plan assumed an open day.
**What it changes:** the timing. इस बार छुट्टी नहीं है.

### 5. रोज़ डे और वैलेंटाइन्स डे कब हैं? — "When are Rose Day and Valentine's Day?"

**Asked as:** रोज़ डे और वैलेंटाइन्स डे कब हैं? (*roz ḍe aur vailenṭāins ḍe kab haiṁ?*)
**Answer:** रोज़ डे रविवार, 7 फ़रवरी 2027 को है। वैलेंटाइन्स डे रविवार, 14 फ़रवरी 2027 को है।
**Behind it:** the week is the real unit; nobody plans one day of it alone.
**What it changes:** both anchors fall on Sundays in 2027, and Propose Day is the workday between them.

## वैलेंटाइन वीक 2027 — all eight dated days

Seven to fourteen February inclusive is eight days, not seven. Weekday names come from Unicode CLDR's `hi-IN` locale, and every weekday was checked four ways: BSD `date`, `cal`, Zeller's congruence written from scratch, and ICU 77.1.

- **7 Feb 2027 — रविवार (ravivār), Sunday** — Rose Day
- **8 Feb 2027 — सोमवार (somvār), Monday** — **Propose Day**
- **9 Feb 2027 — मंगलवार (maṅgalvār), Tuesday** — Chocolate Day
- **10 Feb 2027 — बुधवार (budhvār), Wednesday** — Teddy Day
- **11 Feb 2027 — गुरुवार (guruvār), Thursday** — Promise Day
- **12 Feb 2027 — शुक्रवार (śukravār), Friday** — Hug Day
- **13 Feb 2027 — शनिवार (śanivār), Saturday** — Kiss Day
- **14 Feb 2027 — रविवार (ravivār), Sunday** — Valentine's Day

The English-language calendar page for the same week is at [Propose Day 2027](/blog/propose-day-2027).

One disclosure: सोमवार is not itself a McGregor headword. McGregor gives सोम sense 5 as "Monday", and CLDR gives सोमवार for `hi-IN` — that is the evidence, on a page whose whole job is being right about a date.

## Which page matches the ask on a working Monday

The platform's own creation mix is the closest thing to evidence about what this traffic wants, and it does not point at marriage. All figures below are platform-wide across 21 page types, measured 2026-09-24.

| Page | The ask it actually makes | Pages created, of 5,148 | Share of all pages |
|---|---|---|---|
| "I love you" page (`/love-gf`) | be my girlfriend or boyfriend | 1,178 | 22.9% |
| Apology dashboard (`/apology-dashboard`) | I am sorry | 1,375 | 26.7% |
| Digital bouquet (`/bouquet-gf`) | flowers, without words | 1,178 | 22.9% |
| Will You Marry Me? (`/proposal`) | marriage | no separate figure published | — |

The takeaway is the empty cell. No proposal-specific figure exists — that read is refused by this machine's production-read policy — so nobody, us included, can tell you how proposal pages behave. What the mix does show is that the "I love you" ask is the busiest romantic thing built here, and it is the most-viewed template at 16,998 views, 29.9% of all page views.

So the [proposal scrapbook](/proposal), which ends in a YES button that grows every time they dodge it, is right only if you genuinely mean marriage. For most of this traffic the honest alternative is the [romantic "I love you" page](/love-gf), because it makes the ask Indian usage actually intends. If the Monday problem is time rather than words, [the invitation page](/date-invitation) turns a yes into a countdown and unlocks the plan on the day.

## Why a Hindi question about an English day is a separate question

This keyword exists because someone typed a Hindi question about an occasion with an English name. That is code-mixing inside a query — documented behaviour, not a quirk.

A 2026 study in the *Journal of Medical Internet Research* annotated 4,161 real questions collected in an underserved community in urban Mumbai, all in code-mixed Hinglish, and found that language models capture broad topical intent but fail on euphemism, colloquial phrasing and locally situated questions. The mixed form is not marginal either: a 2024 study in *Humanities & Social Sciences Communications* measured the Hinglish population on Twitter growing from 2014 to 2022 at an annualised 1.2%, with Hinglish usage rising about 2% a year.

Which language a query gets typed in is measurable too. A 2007 study used a 20% sample of Google queries from 227 nations and found a strong preference for the local language: for "avian flu", only 1% of searches from non-English-speaking nations were in English, while for "tuberculosis" and "schizophrenia" the English share ran between roughly 4% and 40%. That reading is old and search has changed since, but the direction it measured is the direction this keyword points in.

And the preference survives when the English version is right there. A 2025 study in *JMIR Formative Research* put seventeen paired epilepsy videos on YouTube, identical content in English and Spanish; over two years the Spanish set drew 11,339 views against the English set's 3,366. Same content, two languages, more than three to one.

## When an English-language page is the wrong thing to send

Here is where SubhSandesh loses. **Every template named on this page is English-language.** You can put your own words in, but the furniture — buttons, labels, prompts — is English. If you searched in Hindi because Hindi is what you and the recipient actually use, a page that answers in English is a compromise, and you should know that before building one.

Two more cases where the answer is not a link. If you will be in the same room on Monday evening, say it in the room. And if it will be read on a laptop in an open-plan office, remember that 48.3% of views here land on a phone, platform-wide; this is built for a handset in a pocket.

One planning number, labelled honestly: the median gap between a page's first save and its last edit is 2.2 hours, sampled on the apology dashboard, n=1,375. That is a per-template figure, not a proposal figure.

## Sources

- ["Understanding User Intent in Code-Mixed Sexual and Reproductive Health Queries in Urban India"](https://www.jmir.org/2026/1/e86545), *Journal of Medical Internet Research*, 24 March 2026
- ["Social, economic, and demographic factors drive the emergence of Hinglish code-mixing on social media"](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41599-024-03058-6), *Humanities & Social Sciences Communications*, 2024
- ["Language preferences on websites and in Google searches for human health and food information"](https://www.jmir.org/2007/2/e18/), *Journal of Medical Internet Research*, 28 June 2007
- ["YouTube User Traffic to Paired Epilepsy Education Videos in English and Spanish"](https://formative.jmir.org/2025/1/e56720), *JMIR Formative Research*, 2025
- [Hindu calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindu_calendar) — entity reference only

Every publisher page above refused this machine's fetcher, so only the abstracts were read, via the Europe PMC and DOAJ APIs. Hindi was checked against McGregor and Platts at the Digital Dictionaries of South Asia, and weekday and month names against Unicode CLDR. It was not reviewed by a native speaker.
